page.layout: One page: a single list of names in a ruled column; year numbers in the right margin; two side notes in the left margin; page number at the head.

l.note: Facta Groning. cum Ostergois: Terræ motus.

page.notes: The year 1314 stands in the right margin beside the ruled space above the first name block and has no names printed beside it. The year 1316 likewise stands beside a blank space with no names. The left margin notes are set in a small bold-looking type; "Groning." is printed with its abbreviation as shown. "Wÿa" is read from a worn stroke over the y and may be mis-read. "Enenis" is uncertain. The initial "I" of Iacobus and Ioannes is printed as a consonant and has been normalised to J.
